source_scope: Official dataset/challenge pages, Bonn Dataverse API file metadata, the 11,277-byte dataset README, and one 664-byte confirmed session-interaction annotation only; no media, sensor streams, or challenge labels opened.

readme.split_metadata_statement: One confirmed session-interaction file contains four timestamped open/close windows; it is not a train/validation split and gives no evidence of group-disjointness

sample_session_annotation.use: Structure-only source preflight; not used for training or evaluation

sample_media_archive_metadata.scope: Public file-page metadata only; archive not downloaded

license.official_dataset_page: CC BY 4.0; official page states commercial use is permitted with attribution
license.participant_consent_scope: UNKNOWN; README reviewed but does not state consent/use scope details
license.product_compatible: LICENSE_DECLARATION_COMPATIBLE; participant/source-specific rights review remains open

task_and_split.challenge_t1: RGB clips to articulation type and axis estimation
task_and_split.challenge_t2: RGB clips to peak force and mechanical work regression; force is the target, not an inference-time input
task_and_split.challenge_split: 40 interactions from two kitchens; hidden ground truth
task_and_split.independent_group_basis: Environment grouping yields 38 reported groups; 381 objects could yield more groups, but object identities, cross-embodiment/session overlap, and candidate split have not been verified

resource_gate.action: NO_MEDIA_OR_SENSOR_PAYLOAD_DOWNLOAD; one 664-byte interaction annotation was inspected and one 1.4 GB RGB archive is reported for a two-interaction example session; total aligned video+sensor subset size remains unknown

decision: REVIEW_NOT_ADMITTED: the published force challenge predicts sensor targets from video rather than requiring synchronized video and force as joint decision inputs; the challenge has only 40 interactions across two kitchens, no verified independent candidate split, and the full release is about 2967 GiB.
